original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: A fork-crowned living-wood ram marks the Thornwake auxiliary breach company.
A piston-lance outrider with a hot pressure vessel marks the Brasshollow auxiliary trial company.
A mourning-cloaked pilot beneath a suspended wakeglass compass marks the Veilmourn auxiliary trial company.
A red lantern pennon and oath shield mark the Embercourt Beaconline commission trial.
A reed-cloaked chain hook and bronze fen bell mark the Mireclaw ambusher trial.
A gold-and-indigo surveyor with a bright prism aperture marks the Sunvault commission trial.
A massive knuckle-walking forest beast carries a high thorn crown, layered bark shoulders, and glowing amber sap seams.
A massive six-legged burrower locks brass-blackstone vault plates over glowing magma seams and immense digging claws.
A tall six-legged cliff runner arrests its charge beneath enormous swept wind-channel horns and slate feather-scales.
A broad peat-dark amphibian braces beneath three translucent turquoise bell throats and a row of luminous mineral vents.
A four-winged white-and-cobalt predator banks around a glacial bell keel with two long forward rake talons.
A heavy four-winged moth bears layered gold-and-cobalt mineral scales around a bright faceted lantern abdomen.
A six-legged basalt auroch with a shovel-horn crown marks the guarded volcanic fold.
A crescent-winged tideglass skyray with hanging resonators marks the guarded coastal roost.
The exact silhouette of Cindervane Censerwings guarding Censerwing Updraft Roost.
The exact silhouette of Fenmirror Gallowshells guarding Fenmirror Shell Basin.
The exact silhouette of Gaugecoil Orewyrms guarding Gaugecoil Pressure Burrow.
The exact silhouette of Gloambell Wake-Mantas guarding Gloambell Sounding Deep.
The exact silhouette of Rootcrown Knotstags guarding Knotstag Root-Court.
The exact silhouette of Prismwake Raylings guarding Prismwake Refraction Shelf.
A compact black-iron mortar with a glowing bell mouth marks Blackbell's red-gauge specialist proving.
A masked mourning chronicler carrying three pale saltglass tablets marks Pale Sounding's last recital.
A pale-barked archer hung with amber-green seedglass chimes marks Crownroot's specialist refrain trial.
The exact ashcrown kilnelk creature silhouette marks this sovereign-wild guard front.
The exact miremoon crownmaws creature silhouette marks this sovereign-wild guard front.
The exact noonshard prism kites creature silhouette marks this sovereign-wild guard front.
The exact quenchbell ironbacks creature silhouette marks this sovereign-wild guard front.
The exact rootvault barkhulks creature silhouette marks this sovereign-wild guard front.
The exact saltwake bellwhales creature silhouette marks this sovereign-wild guard front.
The exact unit_neutral_brambleback_knucklebears creature silhouette marks this unbound-wild guard front.
The exact unit_neutral_harbor_polearms creature silhouette marks this unbound-wild guard front.
The exact unit_neutral_mireglass_belltoads creature silhouette marks this unbound-wild guard front.
The exact unit_neutral_greenbranch_cudgels creature silhouette marks this unbound-wild guard front.
The exact unit_neutral_scarshield_veterans creature silhouette marks this unbound-wild guard front.
The exact unit_neutral_cairnshield_porters creature silhouette marks this unbound-wild guard front.
A broad open timber mill frames a large brass-rimmed saw wheel, log carriage, pale plank stacks, lifting boom, and rear waterwheel.
A moss-roofed two-bay kennel has two dark arched pens, curved antler-like posts, hanging leather leads, and a shallow trough.
Two squat iron-bound timber crates sit beside an assay sack and short pick; one crate is open and filled with rough blue-grey ore.
A stepped stone cut rises around squared blocks, a lifting tripod, ladders, a short ore rail, and an exposed blue-grey mineral seam.
A narrow stone watch post climbs through external zig-zag stairs to a roofed lookout and glowing brazier between forked signal shutters.
A warm roadside lodge shelters a canvas treatment porch, herb racks, water basin, folded blankets, and a round four-leaf lantern.
A low split waystone carries a deep spiral route mark above a leather satchel, two scroll tubes, moss, and three amber pebbles.
A low two-wheel timber wagon carries rope-bound split logs, a side-wedged hatchet, and a rolled green-grey tarp.

source.note: Generated object asset names are best-effort semantic identifications. Runtime mappings intentionally cover only direct or defensible content matches. Live terrain uses the original authored quiet tile bank plus original generated raster surface-detail and grain assets; normal mapped terrain does not receive procedural scratch strokes. The extracted HoMM3 atlas and generated renderer-study payloads remain local reference material and are excluded from official packages.
